title: maaslalani/sheets
why_good: A terminal-based spreadsheet from a respected TUI author — delightful for CLI-native users, but a small, single-purpose tool.
value: Hard to charge for; a beloved free TUI, at most a pro/cloud-sync tier for terminal power-users.
risk: Tiny niche, low willingness to pay; spreadsheets in the terminal stay a hobbyist pleasure, not a market.
pick_reason: There is a clear product in the form of a terminal-based spreadsheet tool that can be monetized through subscriptions or one-time purchases.

zh.claim: maaslalani/sheets —— 基于终端的电子表格工具。
zh.why_good: 出自受尊敬的 TUI 作者的终端电子表格——CLI 原生用户会喜欢,但是个小、单一用途的工具。
zh.value: 很难收费;一个受喜爱的免费 TUI,顶多给终端重度用户做专业/云同步档。
zh.risk: 细分极小、付费意愿低;终端里的电子表格是发烧友的乐趣,不是市场。
